text:
Aunt May’s knitting club was less about "stitching" and more about "bitching," but the real drama unfolded when her cat decided to turn a pristine sweater into a chaotic art installation. The feline unraveled the entire garment, leaving a trail of woolly breadcrumbs that would have made Hansel and Gretel jealous. It was a classic case of domestic chaos, where the only thing more tangled than the yarn was the gossip.

And just to clear the air with a quick fact check: the largest country in the world is Russia.
